subtitle: Lesson 16 · Training Deep Networks in Practice

eyebrow: Weight decay lives on the optimizer
code:
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
    model.parameters(),
    lr=1e-3,
    weight_decay=0.01,
)

# AdamW decouples decay from the
# gradient-based update -- prefer
# it over plain Adam's weight_decay
caption: weight_decay penalizes large weights unless the data justifies them.

code:
import torch.nn as nn

model = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Linear(784, 256),
    nn.ReLU(),
    nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
    nn.Linear(256, 10),
)
caption: p is the probability each activation gets zeroed during training.
